Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_Enabled_tooltip: A survivor outside Knox answers on the radio. Requires the bridge program (bridge/radio_bridge.py) running on the machine that runs the server (or the game in single-player).
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_PlayerCooldown: Delay between two messages of a player (seconds)
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_PlayerCooldown_too: Real time. Limits the cost of the language model.
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_MaxPerHour: Messages per hour, all players (0 = unlimited)
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_MaxPerHour_tooltip: Real time. Each message is one call to the language model.
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_SpontaneousCalls_t: From time to time, the radio voices call out on their frequencies, during their listening hours, so they can be found by scanning.
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_CallLanguage_toolt: Language the radio voices use when they call out on their own, the same for all players. Answers to a player always follow that player's language. Without the bridge program, the short fixed call stays in the server language. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_NoteRarity_tooltip: Readable notes giving the frequency of a radio voice for this game (radio log page, patient card, National Guard notice, scribbled note, Night Owl flyer), found in places that suit each voice. Taken into account when the world loads.
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_ChronicleHour_tool: In-game hour (0 to 23) at which the Night Owl reads the confirmed news of the day on his frequency, once a day. A game day runs from 7 am to 7 am: an hour before 7 am is read at the end of the night. Without the bridge program, a short fixed bulletin built from the same facts is read in the server language. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_LastPages_tooltip: When a character who opened the notebook dies, a locked notebook holding his last pages (written by the language model from his recorded life: days survived, zombies killed, towns, last words on the radio, jobs and rescues; without the bridge program, a short journal built from the same facts) is left in his body or next to it. Off: nothing is recorded and no notebook is left; the records already kept are dropped. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_InitiativeFrequenc: How often a notebook NPC whose body is near you speaks up on his own about something he noticed less than a game hour ago (a known player back, a storm, a death in his group...), when someone hears him and he is not fighting, warning or on alert. Each spoken line written by the language model is one call: the cost shown is the most per real hour for the whole server, also counted in the common limit of NPC requests. Without the bridge program: a short stock line or silence. Can be changed during the game.
Rare: once per NPC per game day (2 calls per real hour at most)
Normal: once per NPC per game hour (6 calls per real hour at most)
Frequent: once per NPC per half game hour (12 calls per real hour at most)
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_RescueDays: Days of supplies of a group to rescue
Sandbox_RadioSurvivor_RescueDays_tooltip: In-game days (1 to 10) of food a stranded group has left when its rescue starts: the time you have to reach them. Supplies only run down while a player is connected, and each delivery adds time (10 days at most). A change applies to the next rescue, not to one already running.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_Enabled: Enable the Living Knox NPC engine
Sandbox_LivingKnox_Enabled_tooltip: Survivor groups simulated by the server: homes, routines, fights, missions in the notebook. Off: no group lives and no NPC appears.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_Debug_tooltip: Writes detailed engine messages to the console log. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_GroupCount_tooltip: Groups created once, when the world starts. Changing it later has no effect on an existing world.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_WeightSettlers_toolti: Relative weight of friendly settlers living in a building when the type of each group is drawn. 0 = no settlers.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_WeightRaiders_tooltip: Relative weight of hostile raiders camping in the forest when the type of each group is drawn. 0 = no raiders.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_WeightNeutrals_toolti: Relative weight of wary neutral survivors living in a building when the type of each group is drawn. 0 = no neutrals.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_GroupSizeMin_tooltip: Kept within the size allowed by each group type (neutral groups: 6 members at most). Taken into account when the groups are created.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_GroupSizeMax_tooltip: Kept within the size allowed by each group type. Must not be below the minimum. The delay of each wiped-out group is drawn between the two values. Taken into account when the groups are created.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ReliefDaysMin: Minimum days before a new group arrives
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ReliefDaysMin_tooltip: In-game days between the end of a wiped-out group and the arrival of a new group elsewhere.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ReliefDaysMax: Maximum days before a new group arrives
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ReliefDaysMax_tooltip: Must not be below the minimum. The delay of each wiped-out group is drawn between the two values.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieAlertDistance_t: A zombie seen or heard by a member farther than this many squares is ignored: no group alert, no interrupted routine, no defense, no fear. Lower it on servers with many zombies. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_AlertReach_tooltip: Members within this many squares of the place where the threat was seen (one floor counts as 3 squares) stop their tasks and turn to it; members farther away also join the defense of the home within this reach. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_AlertShoutZombie: Alert shout radius for a zombie (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_AlertShoutZombie_tool: Radius in squares and volume of the noise made by the member who shouts the alert when the threat is a zombie. The shout also draws zombies: a smaller radius pulls fewer of them toward the home. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_FleeDistance_tooltip: A member who does not fight moves away from a zombie or hostile player closer than this many squares. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_FleeDistanceAfraid: Flee distance of a frightened non-fighter (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_FleeDistanceAfraid_to: Distance in squares at which a very frightened non-fighter moves away from a zombie or hostile player; it also keeps running from what scared it within this distance. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageDeputy: Zombie engage distance of a second-in-command (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageDeputy_to: An able member of role second-in-command attacks the nearest zombie within this many squares without waiting for it to come close; during a home defense, it goes out to meet zombies this close to its post, then comes back. Never beyond the zombie alert distance. A member whose role comes from another mod uses the fighter value. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageFighter: Zombie engage distance of a fighter (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageFighter_t: An able member of role fighter attacks the nearest zombie within this many squares without waiting for it to come close; during a home defense, it goes out to meet zombies this close to its post, then comes back. Never beyond the zombie alert distance. A member whose role comes from another mod uses the fighter value. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageScout: Zombie engage distance of a scout (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageScout_too: An able member of role scout attacks the nearest zombie within this many squares without waiting for it to come close; during a home defense, it goes out to meet zombies this close to its post, then comes back. Never beyond the zombie alert distance. A member whose role comes from another mod uses the fighter value. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageMedic: Zombie engage distance of a medic (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageMedic_too: An able member of role medic attacks the nearest zombie within this many squares without waiting for it to come close; during a home defense, it goes out to meet zombies this close to its post, then comes back. Never beyond the zombie alert distance. A member whose role comes from another mod uses the fighter value. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageWorker: Zombie engage distance of a worker (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageWorker_to: An able member of role worker attacks the nearest zombie within this many squares without waiting for it to come close; during a home defense, it goes out to meet zombies this close to its post, then comes back. Never beyond the zombie alert distance. A member whose role comes from another mod uses the fighter value. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageBreaker: Zombie engage distance of a breaker (squares)
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ZombieEngageBreaker_t: An able member of role breaker attacks the nearest zombie within this many squares without waiting for it to come close; during a home defense, it goes out to meet zombies this close to its post, then comes back. Never beyond the zombie alert distance. A member whose role comes from another mod uses the fighter value. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_DefenseRadius_tooltip: During an alert, threats within this many squares of the home start its defense: fighters take their posts, the others take shelter inside. Zombies count only within the zombie alert distance. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_DefenseWithdrawRatio_: The group withdraws inside when the threat exceeds this many times the number of able fighters (a hostile player counts as 3 zombies); fighters go back to their posts at this value minus one. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_RetreatDangerDistance: A wounded member, or a fighter at the end of his nerves, retreats when a threat is closer than this many squares. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_ReinforcementRadius_t: When a member is hit, fighters on the same floor within this many squares come to help. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_WarnHomeRadius_toolti: A player the group distrusts is warned when he comes within this many squares of the home; half of it is the safety distance that speeds up the warnings. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_WarnGroupRadius_toolt: Same as above, in squares around a member away from the home or of a group without a home. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_WoundedHealth_tooltip: A member whose health falls below this percentage of his health at birth is wounded: he no longer fights, rests at the home and runs from close threats. Also used by the home defense. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_AfraidFear_tooltip: A member whose fear reaches this value is afraid: he no longer fights, shelters at the home, runs from what scared him and does not leave on expeditions. Also used by the home defense. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_RaidsEnabled_tooltip: A raider group that spots a player base (vanilla safehouse, running generator, barricades, constructions) on two different days first sends one or two scouts; if they are killed the raid is called off, otherwise the raid is announced and the group attacks with its own members a day later. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_RaidDays_tooltip: Minimum number of in-game days between two raids (departures of the scouts), and before the first one. Can be changed during the game.
Sandbox_LivingKnox_RevengeDelayHours_too: In-game hours (12 to 336) between the moment a group swears revenge for a member you killed and the departure of its first team. A change applies to the next oath, not to a revenge already sworn.
